title: Warehouse Map

purpose.en: The floor plan of one warehouse building: its storage areas and bins, per floor. Open it to see where stock is, how full each bin is by weight and by volume, and which bins hold dead or expired stock.
purpose.id: Denah satu gedung gudang: area penyimpanan dan bin-nya, per lantai. Buka untuk melihat stok ada di mana, seberapa penuh tiap bin menurut berat dan volume, dan bin mana yang berisi dead stock atau stok kedaluwarsa.

keywords: warehouse map, peta gudang, denah gudang, mapping, layout, bin, lokasi, rak, lantai, floor, dead stock, stok mati, kapasitas, capacity, gedung, volume, m3, kedaluwarsa, expired, expiry, stack, tumpukan, sisa, remnant, tertimbun

steps.en: Choose the Building and click Show. A building with more than one floor has a tab per floor.
steps.id: Pilih Building lalu klik Show. Gedung yang punya lebih dari satu lantai punya tab per lantai.

steps.en: Read the colours: white = empty, blue = in use, yellow = full, orange = over capacity, hatched = blocked, red = holds dead stock.
steps.id: Baca warnanya: putih = kosong, biru = terisi, kuning = penuh, oranye = lebih dari kapasitas, berarsir = diblokir, merah = berisi dead stock.

steps.en: Click a bin. The panel shows its items, the capacity in use, its QR code and, for a rack, a button per level.
steps.id: Klik sebuah bin. Panel menampilkan isi bin, kapasitas terpakai, QR code-nya dan, untuk rak, tombol per tingkat.

steps.en: Type in the search box to highlight the bins that hold an item, a lot or match a bin code. Click a colour in the legend to see only those bins.
steps.id: Ketik di kotak cari untuk menyorot bin yang berisi item, lot, atau cocok dengan kode bin. Klik warna di legenda untuk melihat bin itu saja.

steps.en: Transfer makes a draft Stock Transfer with everything in the bin. Label prints the bin label. Block stops a bin from receiving stock and asks for the reason.
steps.id: Transfer membuat draft Stock Transfer berisi semua isi bin. Label mencetak label bin. Block menghentikan bin menerima stok dan meminta alasannya.

steps.en: Edit Layout: drag a storage area to move it, or drag its corner to resize it. The new position is saved at once.
steps.id: Edit Layout: seret area penyimpanan untuk memindahkannya, atau seret sudutnya untuk mengubah ukurannya. Posisi baru langsung tersimpan.

steps.en: Generate Bins: choose a storage area, the lanes and slots (or racks, columns and levels) and the capacity per bin, then Generate.
steps.id: Generate Bins: pilih area penyimpanan, lajur dan slot (atau rak, kolom, dan tingkat) serta kapasitas per bin, lalu Generate.

steps.en: A yellow dot on a bin means it holds stock that is expired or expires soon. Click Expired / expires soon above the map to see only those bins.
steps.id: Titik kuning di bin berarti berisi stok yang kedaluwarsa atau segera kedaluwarsa. Klik Expired / expires soon di atas peta untuk melihat bin itu saja.

steps.en: Read the Capacity per Floor table. It shows the floor area, clear height and room volume of each floor, how much of it is storage area, and how much is in use (m3 and kg).
steps.id: Baca tabel Capacity per Floor. Isinya luas lantai, tinggi bersih dan volume ruang tiap lantai, berapa yang menjadi area penyimpanan, dan berapa yang terpakai (m3 dan kg).

steps.en: The small number in a bin is how many labelled pallets and packs are stacked there. A violet dot = it holds a remnant, an orange dot = the unit to use first is buried.
steps.id: Angka kecil di bin = jumlah palet dan pak berlabel yang ditumpuk di sana. Titik ungu = berisi sisa, titik oranye = satuan yang harus dipakai dulu tertimbun.

steps.en: In the bin panel, Stack shows the units from the top down; number 1 is the bottom. Use the arrows to swap a unit with the one above or below when the pile was rearranged.
steps.id: Di panel bin, Stack menampilkan satuan dari atas ke bawah; nomor 1 paling bawah. Pakai panah untuk menukar satuan dengan yang di atas atau di bawahnya bila tumpukan diubah.

steps.en: Click Remnant or Buried above the map to see only those bins. Stack Monitor lists every stack in one table.
steps.id: Klik Remnant atau Buried di atas peta untuk melihat bin itu saja. Stack Monitor mendaftar semua tumpukan dalam satu tabel.

fields.label: Building
fields.en: The warehouse building to show. Buildings are added in Buildings.
fields.id: Gedung gudang yang ditampilkan. Gedung ditambah di Buildings.

fields.label: Capacity
fields.en: Estimated weight in the bin against its capacity in kg. Items without weight data are not counted and are mentioned below the bar.
fields.id: Perkiraan berat isi bin dibanding kapasitasnya dalam kg. Item tanpa data berat tidak dihitung dan disebut di bawah garisnya.

fields.label: Dead stock
fields.en: The item has not moved for longer than the dead stock limit in Settings, Constants. Moving it to another bin does not count as a movement.
fields.id: Item tidak bergerak lebih lama dari batas dead stock di Settings, Constants. Memindahkannya ke bin lain tidak dihitung sebagai pergerakan.

fields.label: Storage area
fields.en: In Generate Bins: the area that gets the new bins. Its way of storing decides the bin codes.
fields.id: Di Generate Bins: area yang mendapat bin baru. Cara simpannya menentukan kode bin.

fields.label: Lane / rack from
fields.en: First lane (floor area) or rack (rack area) to make.
fields.id: Lajur (area lantai) atau rak (area rak) pertama yang dibuat.

fields.label: Lane / rack to
fields.en: Last lane or rack to make.
fields.id: Lajur atau rak terakhir yang dibuat.

fields.label: Slot / column from
fields.en: First slot in a lane, or first column of a rack.
fields.id: Slot pertama dalam lajur, atau kolom pertama rak.

fields.label: Slot / column to
fields.en: Last slot or column.
fields.id: Slot atau kolom terakhir.

fields.label: Levels (rack)
fields.en: How many levels each rack column has. Used for a rack area only.
fields.id: Jumlah tingkat tiap kolom rak. Hanya dipakai untuk area rak.

fields.label: Capacity per bin (kg)
fields.en: Weight capacity given to every new bin. It can be changed per bin in Bins.
fields.id: Kapasitas berat untuk tiap bin baru. Bisa diubah per bin di Bins.

fields.label: Pallets per bin
fields.en: How many pallets fit in every new bin. Printed on the bin label.
fields.id: Jumlah pallet yang muat di tiap bin baru. Tercetak di label bin.

fields.label: Weight / Volume / Floor area × height
fields.en: In the bin panel. Weight = stock weight against the kg capacity of the bin. Volume = estimated stock volume against the bin volume. Floor area x height = size of the bin: its storage area divided by its positions, times the stacking height.
fields.id: Di panel bin. Weight = berat stok terhadap kapasitas kg bin. Volume = perkiraan volume stok terhadap volume bin. Floor area x height = ukuran bin: luas area penyimpanannya dibagi jumlah posisinya, dikali tinggi tumpuk.

fields.label: Capacity per Floor
fields.en: One row per floor. The clear height of a floor is filled in Buildings; the stacking height of an area in Storage Areas. A floor without a height has no volume.
fields.id: Satu baris per lantai. Tinggi bersih lantai diisi di Buildings; tinggi tumpuk area di Storage Areas. Lantai tanpa tinggi tidak punya volume.

fields.label: Stack
fields.en: How many labelled units are in the bin and how many of them are pallets. A remnant pack is not counted as a pallet.
fields.id: Berapa satuan berlabel di bin dan berapa di antaranya palet. Pak sisa tidak dihitung sebagai palet.

fields.label: Stack height
fields.en: Estimated height of the pile (sheets x thickness, plus the wooden pallet) against the stacking height of the bin.
fields.id: Perkiraan tinggi tumpukan (lembar x tebal, ditambah palet kayu) dibanding tinggi tumpuk bin.

fields.label: Buried
fields.en: The unit that should be used first (a remnant, else the earliest expiry, else the oldest arrival) has another pallet on top of it.
fields.id: Satuan yang seharusnya dipakai lebih dulu (sisa, lalu kedaluwarsa paling awal, lalu tiba paling lama) ditindih palet lain.

fields.label: Remnant
fields.en: A pack: loose reams, boxes or cans left after use. Old remnant = it arrived longer ago than the dead stock limit.
fields.id: Pak: rim, dus, atau kaleng lepas sisa pemakaian. Old remnant = tibanya lebih lama dari batas dead stock.

title: Stock Transfer

purpose.en: Move stock from one bin to another, in the same warehouse or to another warehouse. Open it whenever goods change place, so the stock card and the Warehouse Map stay right.
purpose.id: Memindahkan stok dari satu bin ke bin lain, di gudang yang sama atau ke gudang lain. Buka setiap kali barang berpindah tempat, supaya kartu stok dan Warehouse Map tetap benar.

keywords: stock transfer, transfer stok, pindah stok, mutasi, pindah gudang, pindah bin, moving item, antar gudang, tf, dead stock, approval transfer, persetujuan, palet, pallet, volume

steps.en: Click + New Record, choose From warehouse and To warehouse, then Create. The same warehouse on both sides means a move between bins.
steps.id: Klik + New Record, pilih From warehouse dan To warehouse, lalu Create. Gudang yang sama di kedua sisi berarti pindah antar bin.

steps.en: Click + Item. Pick the item in its source bin, the destination bin and the quantity to move. Repeat for every item.
steps.id: Klik + Item. Pilih item di bin asalnya, bin tujuan, dan qty yang dipindah. Ulangi untuk tiap item.

steps.en: Click Save. Bins & Capacity shows per line how full the destination bin is after the move and marks dead stock in red.
steps.id: Klik Save. Bins & Capacity menampilkan per baris seberapa penuh bin tujuan sesudah pindah dan menandai dead stock dengan merah.

steps.en: Click Confirm. The stock moves on the stock card, the transfer gets its number and can be printed. Nothing can be changed after that.
steps.id: Klik Confirm. Stok pindah di kartu stok, transfer mendapat nomornya dan bisa dicetak. Sesudah itu tidak ada yang bisa diubah.

steps.en: To undo a confirmed transfer click Cancel and give the reason. The stock goes back to the source bins if it is still in the destination bins.
steps.id: Untuk membatalkan transfer yang sudah Confirm klik Cancel dan isi alasannya. Stok kembali ke bin asal bila masih ada di bin tujuan.

steps.en: Bin Labels shows the capacity label of every bin on the transfer with its QR code and barcode. Print Labels prints them.
steps.id: Bin Labels menampilkan label kapasitas tiap bin di transfer ini beserta QR code dan barcode-nya. Print Labels mencetaknya.

steps.en: Labelled pallets follow the stock: a transfer that empties a bin moves all its pallets; a part of the stock moves the oldest pallets when their quantities add up exactly. Otherwise the pallets stay and Print Pallet Label shows what to relabel.
steps.id: Palet berlabel ikut pindah: transfer yang mengosongkan bin memindahkan semua paletnya; sebagian stok memindahkan palet tertua bila jumlahnya persis sama. Kalau tidak, palet tetap di tempat dan Print Pallet Label menunjukkan yang perlu dilabel ulang.

steps.en: Approval is switched off by default: Confirm moves the stock at once. When it is switched on in Setup > Setting Approval (module TF), Confirm sends the transfer for approval and the stock moves only after the last approval.
steps.id: Approval bawaannya mati: Confirm langsung memindahkan stok. Bila dinyalakan di Setup > Setting Approval (modul TF), Confirm mengajukan transfer untuk approval dan stok baru pindah sesudah approval terakhir.

fields.label: From warehouse
fields.en: The building the stock leaves. It cannot be changed after the draft is created.
fields.id: Gedung asal stok. Tidak bisa diubah setelah draft dibuat.

fields.label: To warehouse
fields.en: The building that receives the stock. After changing it, Save first and choose the destination bins again.
fields.id: Gedung yang menerima stok. Setelah mengubahnya, Save dulu lalu pilih lagi bin tujuannya.

fields.label: Date
fields.en: Date of the transfer, today or earlier. The stock itself moves at the moment of Confirm.
fields.id: Tanggal transfer, hari ini atau sebelumnya. Stoknya sendiri pindah saat Confirm.

fields.label: Reason
fields.en: Why the stock is moved: replenish an area, tidy up, bring to production, move dead stock aside, or other.
fields.id: Alasan stok dipindah: mengisi area, merapikan, membawa ke produksi, menyingkirkan dead stock, atau lainnya.

fields.label: Carried By
fields.en: Name of the person who moves the goods. Printed on the transfer.
fields.id: Nama orang yang memindahkan barang. Tercetak di transfer.

fields.label: Item | Source Bin | On Hand
fields.en: Stock that is in a bin of the source warehouse now. The list shows the item, its bin, the quantity on hand and DEAD STOCK when it applies.
fields.id: Stok yang sekarang ada di bin gudang asal. Daftar menampilkan item, bin-nya, qty yang ada, dan DEAD STOCK bila berlaku.

fields.label: Destination Bin | Free Capacity
fields.en: A usable bin of the destination warehouse, with the weight it can still take. Blocked bins are not listed.
fields.id: Bin gudang tujuan yang bisa dipakai, beserta berat yang masih bisa ditampung. Bin yang diblokir tidak muncul.

fields.label: Qty to Move
fields.en: How much goes to the destination bin. It may not be more than the quantity on hand in the source bin.
fields.id: Jumlah yang dipindah ke bin tujuan. Tidak boleh lebih dari qty yang ada di bin asal.

fields.label: Lot No.
fields.en: Lot or batch written on the goods, when there is one. Printed on the transfer.
fields.id: Nomor lot atau batch yang tertulis di barang, bila ada. Tercetak di transfer.

fields.label: Check
fields.en: OK, Over capacity (the destination bin gets fuller than its capacity; you may still Confirm), Dead stock, or No destination.
fields.id: OK, Over capacity (bin tujuan jadi lebih penuh dari kapasitasnya; tetap boleh Confirm), Dead stock, atau No destination.

title: Stock Transfer Approval Center

purpose.en: The stock transfers that wait for your approval. This approval is switched off by default; while it is off, Confirm on a transfer moves the stock at once and nothing arrives here.
purpose.id: Stock transfer yang menunggu approval Anda. Approval ini bawaannya mati; selama mati, Confirm di transfer langsung memindahkan stok dan tidak ada yang masuk ke sini.

keywords: approval transfer, persetujuan transfer, stock transfer approval, pindah stok, setuju, tolak, hold, setting approval, tf

steps.en: To switch it on: Setup > Setting Approval, open module TF, set the position that approves, then Activate. Deactivate switches it off again.
steps.id: Untuk menyalakan: Setup > Setting Approval, buka modul TF, isi jabatan yang menyetujui, lalu Activate. Deactivate mematikannya lagi.

steps.en: Open a transfer in the list to see its route, lines and the capacity check of the destination bins.
steps.id: Buka satu transfer di daftar untuk melihat rute, baris, dan pemeriksaan kapasitas bin tujuannya.

steps.en: Approve moves the stock when you are the last level. Reject stops the transfer; no stock moves. Hold keeps it in your list. Reject and Hold need a reason.
steps.id: Approve memindahkan stok bila Anda level terakhir. Reject menghentikan transfer; tidak ada stok yang pindah. Hold menahannya di daftar Anda. Reject dan Hold wajib alasan.

steps.en: The arrow icon next to the transfer number opens the transfer itself on the Stock Transfer screen. Once you have decided, the Decision Log lists your 20 latest decisions with the level and the reason.
steps.id: Ikon panah di samping nomor transfer membuka transfernya di layar Stock Transfer. Setelah Anda memutuskan, Decision Log menampilkan 20 keputusan terakhir Anda beserta level dan alasannya.

steps.en: Approve first checks that the stock can really move. If it cannot, the message is shown and your approval is not saved. After Hold the transfer stays in your list; only Approve or Reject is left.
steps.id: Approve lebih dulu memeriksa apakah stok benar-benar bisa dipindah. Bila tidak bisa, pesannya tampil dan persetujuan Anda tidak disimpan. Setelah Hold, transfer tetap di daftar Anda; tinggal Approve atau Reject.

fields.label: Stock Transfer Waiting for My Approval
fields.en: The transfers waiting at your approval level. Each entry shows the transfer number, the stock value, the route, the date and Level n / N; On hold appears when it was held. The number waiting is shown beside the title.
fields.id: Transfer yang menunggu di level approval Anda. Tiap entri menampilkan nomor transfer, nilai stok, rute, tanggal, dan Level n / N; On hold muncul bila ditahan. Jumlah yang menunggu tampil di samping judul.

fields.label: Submitted by
fields.en: The login of the person who sent the transfer for approval. It is shown under the transfer number, next to the route.
fields.id: Login orang yang mengajukan transfer untuk approval. Tampil di bawah nomor transfer, di samping rute.

fields.label: Approval Level
fields.en: The level the transfer waits at now, for example Level 2 of 3, with the role of that level. The small marks beside it show how far the levels have gone.
fields.id: Level tempat transfer menunggu sekarang, misalnya Level 2 of 3, beserta peran level itu. Tanda kecil di sampingnya menunjukkan sampai level mana prosesnya.

fields.label: Route
fields.en: The warehouse the stock leaves and the warehouse it goes to, as warehouse codes. Taken from the transfer.
fields.id: Gudang asal stok dan gudang tujuannya, dalam kode gudang. Diambil dari transfer.

fields.label: Reason
fields.en: In the transfer: why the stock is moved, for example Replenish a storage area or Bring to production. In the Reject and Hold box: your reason, required, kept in the Document History and the Decision Log.
fields.id: Di transfer: alasan stok dipindah, misalnya Replenish a storage area atau Bring to production. Di kotak Reject dan Hold: alasan Anda, wajib diisi, tersimpan di Document History dan Decision Log.

fields.label: Stock value
fields.en: The value of the stock in the transfer, in IDR, worked out by the system. It is not typed.
fields.id: Nilai stok dalam transfer, dalam IDR, dihitung sistem. Tidak diketik.

fields.label: Carried By
fields.en: Name of the person who moves the goods, typed on the transfer.
fields.id: Nama orang yang memindahkan barang, diketik di transfer.

fields.label: Lines
fields.en: The number of item lines in the transfer.
fields.id: Jumlah baris item dalam transfer.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item code and name of the line.
fields.id: Kode dan nama item pada baris.

fields.label: Qty
fields.en: The quantity to move on the line.
fields.id: Jumlah yang dipindah pada baris.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: The unit of the quantity.
fields.id: Satuan dari jumlah itu.

fields.label: From Bin
fields.en: The bin the stock is taken from.
fields.id: Bin tempat stok diambil.

fields.label: To Bin
fields.en: The bin the stock is put in. A dash means no destination bin was chosen.
fields.id: Bin tempat stok diletakkan. Tanda strip berarti bin tujuan belum dipilih.

fields.label: Check
fields.en: OK, Dead stock, Over capacity or No destination. Over capacity: the destination bin would hold more than its weight or volume capacity once this line and the earlier lines to the same bin are added. Dead stock shows first if two apply.
fields.id: OK, Dead stock, Over capacity, atau No destination. Over capacity: bin tujuan akan melebihi kapasitas berat atau volumenya setelah baris ini dan baris sebelumnya ke bin yang sama ditambahkan. Dead stock tampil lebih dulu bila dua-duanya berlaku.

fields.label: Approval Flow
fields.en: The levels the transfer must pass, each with its role and the person who holds it, and who decided and when. PLT marks a decision made by an acting officer.
fields.id: Level yang harus dilalui transfer, masing-masing dengan perannya dan pemegangnya, serta siapa yang memutuskan dan kapan. PLT menandai keputusan yang diambil pelaksana tugas.

fields.label: Document History
fields.en: What happened to the transfer: submitted, approved, rejected or hold, who did it, when, and the reason that was typed.
fields.id: Apa yang terjadi pada transfer: diajukan, disetujui, ditolak, atau hold, siapa yang melakukan, kapan, dan alasan yang diketik.

fields.label: Decision Log
fields.en: Your own latest decisions: the transfer number, approved, rejected or hold, the level and the reason. It appears only after you have decided something.
fields.id: Keputusan terakhir Anda sendiri: nomor transfer, disetujui, ditolak, atau hold, levelnya, dan alasannya. Baru tampil setelah Anda mengambil keputusan.

title: Stack Monitor

purpose.en: Every labelled pallet and pack with its place in the stack of its bin. Open it to see what lies on what, which remnants are old, and where the unit to use first is buried.
purpose.id: Semua palet dan pak berlabel dengan letaknya dalam tumpukan bin-nya. Buka untuk melihat apa menindih apa, sisa mana yang sudah lama, dan di mana satuan yang harus dipakai dulu tertimbun.

keywords: stack monitor, tumpukan, tumpuk, stack, sisa, remnant, sisa rim, rim, tertimbun, buried, tinggi tumpukan, palet, pak, kertas, ambri, sheet, x y stack, posisi barang

steps.en: The table opens grouped by bin. Stack 3 / 3 is the top of three units; 1 / 3 is the bottom.
steps.id: Tabel terbuka terkelompok per bin. Stack 3 / 3 = paling atas dari tiga satuan; 1 / 3 = paling bawah.

steps.en: Click Buried, Remnant, Old remnant, Near height limit or Stack not recorded above the table to see only those rows.
steps.id: Klik Buried, Remnant, Old remnant, Near height limit, atau Stack not recorded di atas tabel untuk melihat baris itu saja.

steps.en: Stack not recorded = stock in a bin without a label, so its place in the stack is unknown. Open the row to make its label.
steps.id: Stack not recorded = stok di bin tanpa label, jadi letaknya dalam tumpukan belum diketahui. Buka barisnya untuk membuat labelnya.

steps.en: Open on a row goes to Print Pallet Label for that unit: relabel it, move a remnant to another pile, or print the label again.
steps.id: Open di sebuah baris membuka Print Pallet Label untuk satuan itu: label ulang, pindahkan sisa ke tumpukan lain, atau cetak ulang labelnya.

steps.en: To change the order of a stack, open the bin on Warehouse Map and use the arrows in the Stack list.
steps.id: Untuk mengubah urutan tumpukan, buka bin-nya di Warehouse Map dan pakai panah di daftar Stack.

fields.label: Bin
fields.en: The bin (lane and slot, or rack and level) where the unit is.
fields.id: Bin (lajur dan slot, atau rak dan tingkat) tempat satuan itu berada.

fields.label: Stack
fields.en: Place in the stack / number of units in the bin. 1 is the bottom.
fields.id: Letak dalam tumpukan / jumlah satuan di bin. 1 paling bawah.

fields.label: Kind
fields.en: Pallet, Pack (a remnant), or not labelled.
fields.id: Pallet, Pack (sisa), atau belum berlabel.

fields.label: Pallet / Pack No.
fields.en: The number on the label of the unit.
fields.id: Nomor di label satuan itu.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code below.
fields.id: Nama item dengan kodenya di bawah.

fields.label: Qty
fields.en: Quantity on the label now.
fields.id: Qty di label sekarang.

fields.label: Arrived
fields.en: The date the unit arrived.
fields.id: Tanggal satuan itu tiba.

fields.label: Age (days)
fields.en: Days since the unit arrived.
fields.id: Jumlah hari sejak satuan itu tiba.

fields.label: Height in Bin
fields.en: Estimated height of the whole stack against the stacking height of the bin.
fields.id: Perkiraan tinggi seluruh tumpukan dibanding tinggi tumpuk bin.

fields.label: Stack Height
fields.en: OK, Near height limit, Over height limit, or Over stack limit (more pallets than the area allows).
fields.id: OK, Near height limit, Over height limit, atau Over stack limit (palet lebih banyak dari yang diizinkan area).

fields.label: Remnant
fields.en: Remnant = a pack left after use. Old remnant = it arrived longer ago than the dead stock limit.
fields.id: Remnant = pak sisa pemakaian. Old remnant = tibanya lebih lama dari batas dead stock.

fields.label: Buried
fields.en: The unit to use first has another pallet on top of it. Units Above tells how many must be moved.
fields.id: Satuan yang harus dipakai dulu ditindih palet lain. Units Above = berapa yang harus dipindah dulu.

fields.label: Record
fields.en: Recorded = the unit has a label. Stack not recorded = stock without a label.
fields.id: Recorded = satuan itu berlabel. Stack not recorded = stok tanpa label.

title: Buildings

purpose.en: The list of warehouse buildings with their size, shape and number of floors. Open it to add a building or to correct its measurements; the Warehouse Map is drawn from it.
purpose.id: Daftar gedung gudang beserta ukuran, bentuk, dan jumlah lantainya. Buka untuk menambah gedung atau membetulkan ukurannya; Warehouse Map digambar dari sini.

keywords: building, gedung, gudang, warehouse, ukuran gudang, bentuk gudang, huruf l, l shape, lantai, floor, a5, a6, a10, tambah gudang, tinggi gedung, tinggi lantai, clear height, volume

steps.en: To add a building, add a row and type its Code and Building Name.
steps.id: Untuk menambah gedung, tambah baris lalu ketik Code dan Building Name-nya.

steps.en: Fill Length and Width in metres and choose the number of Floors.
steps.id: Isi Length dan Width dalam meter dan pilih jumlah Floors.

steps.en: Choose the Shape. For an L shape also fill the cut-out length, width and corner. For a custom outline type the corner points.
steps.id: Pilih Shape. Untuk bentuk huruf L isi juga panjang, lebar, dan sudut potongannya. Untuk garis luar sendiri ketik titik-titik sudutnya.

steps.en: Click Save. Then add the storage areas of the building in Storage Areas.
steps.id: Klik Save. Lalu tambahkan area penyimpanan gedung itu di Storage Areas.

fields.label: Code
fields.en: Short code of the building, for example A10. It becomes the first part of every bin code and cannot be changed after saving.
fields.id: Kode singkat gedung, misalnya A10. Menjadi bagian pertama setiap kode bin dan tidak bisa diubah setelah disimpan.

fields.label: Building Name
fields.en: Name of the building as people call it.
fields.id: Nama gedung seperti yang biasa disebut.

fields.label: Stock Kept
fields.en: The kind of stock the building mostly keeps. Mixed when it keeps several kinds; the storage areas say it more precisely.
fields.id: Jenis stok yang terutama disimpan di gedung. Mixed bila beberapa jenis; area penyimpanan menyebutnya lebih tepat.

fields.label: Length (m)
fields.en: Long side of the building in metres, left to right on the map.
fields.id: Sisi panjang gedung dalam meter, kiri ke kanan di peta.

fields.label: Width (m)
fields.en: Short side of the building in metres, top to bottom on the map.
fields.id: Sisi lebar gedung dalam meter, atas ke bawah di peta.

fields.label: Floors
fields.en: Number of floors, 1 to 3. Each floor has its own map.
fields.id: Jumlah lantai, 1 sampai 3. Tiap lantai punya petanya sendiri.

fields.label: Shape
fields.en: Rectangle, L shape, or a custom outline.
fields.id: Kotak, huruf L, atau garis luar sendiri.

fields.label: Cut-out Length (m)
fields.en: L shape only: how long the missing corner is, along the length.
fields.id: Hanya huruf L: panjang sudut yang hilang, searah panjang gedung.

fields.label: Cut-out Width (m)
fields.en: L shape only: how wide the missing corner is, along the width.
fields.id: Hanya huruf L: lebar sudut yang hilang, searah lebar gedung.

fields.label: Cut-out Corner
fields.en: L shape only: which corner is missing.
fields.id: Hanya huruf L: sudut mana yang hilang.

fields.label: Custom Outline (m)
fields.en: Custom shape only: the corner points in metres, clockwise from the top left, like 0,0; 30,0; 30,12; 0,12.
fields.id: Hanya bentuk sendiri: titik-titik sudut dalam meter, searah jarum jam dari kiri atas, seperti 0,0; 30,0; 30,12; 0,12.

fields.label: Address
fields.en: Address of the building. Printed on the Stock Transfer when it is the destination.
fields.id: Alamat gedung. Tercetak di Stock Transfer bila gedung itu tujuannya.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Untick to stop using the building. It disappears from the choices; its stock records stay.
fields.id: Hilangkan centang untuk berhenti memakai gedung. Gedung hilang dari pilihan; catatan stoknya tetap ada.

fields.label: Clear Height Floor 1 / 2 / 3 (m)
fields.en: Height of each floor from the floor to the lowest beam, in metres. Floor area x height is the room volume of that floor. An estimate is fine; the warehouse officer corrects it later.
fields.id: Tinggi tiap lantai dari lantai sampai balok terendah, dalam meter. Luas lantai x tinggi = volume ruang lantai itu. Perkiraan dulu tidak apa-apa; petugas gudang memperbaikinya nanti.

title: Storage Areas

purpose.en: The storage areas inside each building and floor, such as Receiving, Plano Paper or Finished Goods. Open it to add an area or change its use, size and place on the map.
purpose.id: Area penyimpanan di tiap gedung dan lantai, seperti Receiving, Plano Paper, atau Finished Goods. Buka untuk menambah area atau mengubah kegunaan, ukuran, dan letaknya di peta.

keywords: storage area, area penyimpanan, zona, zone, area gudang, receiving, staging, shipping, rak, lantai, tambah area, tinggi tumpuk, stack height, volume

steps.en: Add a row, choose the Building and the Floor, and type the Code and Area Name.
steps.id: Tambah baris, pilih Building dan Floor, lalu ketik Code dan Area Name.

steps.en: Choose Use, How Stored and Stock Class. Then choose Mixing and Pick Order, and type Count Every if the area must be counted on a schedule.
steps.id: Pilih Use, How Stored, dan Stock Class. Lalu pilih Mixing dan Pick Order, dan isi Count Every bila area harus dihitung berkala.

steps.en: Fill X, Y, Width and Depth in metres, or leave them and drag the area on the Warehouse Map with Edit Layout.
steps.id: Isi X, Y, Width, dan Depth dalam meter, atau biarkan lalu seret areanya di Warehouse Map lewat Edit Layout.

steps.en: Click Save. Then make the bins of the area with Generate Bins on the Warehouse Map.
steps.id: Klik Save. Lalu buat bin area itu lewat Generate Bins di Warehouse Map.

fields.label: Building
fields.en: The building the area is in. It cannot be changed after saving.
fields.id: Gedung tempat area berada. Tidak bisa diubah setelah disimpan.

fields.label: Floor
fields.en: The floor of the building. It may not be higher than the number of floors of that building.
fields.id: Lantai gedung. Tidak boleh lebih tinggi dari jumlah lantai gedung itu.

fields.label: Code
fields.en: Short code of the area, at most 6 letters or digits, for example PPR. It becomes part of the bin codes and cannot be changed after saving.
fields.id: Kode singkat area, paling panjang 6 huruf atau angka, misalnya PPR. Menjadi bagian kode bin dan tidak bisa diubah setelah disimpan.

fields.label: Area Name
fields.en: Name of the area shown on the map and on the labels.
fields.id: Nama area yang tampil di peta dan di label.

fields.label: Use
fields.en: What the area is for: receiving, QC hold, storage, staging, shipping, reject, consignment, tooling or WIP. At Subcontractor, In Transit and Loss are virtual: no map place and no bins.
fields.id: Kegunaan area: penerimaan, karantina QC, simpan, staging, kirim, reject, titipan, tooling, atau WIP. At Subcontractor, In Transit, dan Loss bersifat virtual: tanpa tempat di peta dan tanpa bin.

fields.label: Mixing
fields.en: Mixed items, One item per bin or One batch per bin. Putaway and transfer only suggest or accept bins that follow this rule.
fields.id: Mixed items, One item per bin, atau One batch per bin. Putaway dan transfer hanya menyarankan atau menerima bin yang mengikuti aturan ini.

fields.label: Pick Order
fields.en: FIFO takes the oldest received stock first, FEFO the earliest expiry first. Pick List uses it to choose pallets and bins.
fields.id: FIFO mengambil stok yang paling lama diterima lebih dulu, FEFO yang paling cepat kedaluwarsa. Pick List memakainya untuk memilih palet dan bin.

fields.label: Count Every (days)
fields.en: How often the area must be counted, in days (1 to 365). Empty = no schedule. Count Tasks use it to propose counts.
fields.id: Seberapa sering area harus dihitung, dalam hari (1 sampai 365). Kosong = tanpa jadwal. Count Tasks memakainya untuk mengusulkan hitungan.

fields.label: Virtual
fields.en: Ticked by the system when Use is a virtual area. It cannot be typed.
fields.id: Dicentang sistem bila Use adalah area virtual. Tidak bisa diketik.

fields.label: How Stored
fields.en: Rack (racks, columns, levels), Floor (lanes and slots of pallets) or Open area (the whole area is one bin).
fields.id: Rack (rak, kolom, tingkat), Floor (lajur dan slot pallet), atau Open area (seluruh area adalah satu bin).

fields.label: Stock Class
fields.en: The class of stock meant for the area: raw material, semi finished, finished goods, or any.
fields.id: Kelas stok yang dimaksudkan untuk area: bahan baku, setengah jadi, barang jadi, atau apa saja.

fields.label: X (m)
fields.en: Distance of the area from the left wall, in metres.
fields.id: Jarak area dari dinding kiri, dalam meter.

fields.label: Y (m)
fields.en: Distance of the area from the top wall, in metres.
fields.id: Jarak area dari dinding atas, dalam meter.

fields.label: Width (m)
fields.en: Size of the area from left to right. X plus Width must stay inside the building.
fields.id: Ukuran area dari kiri ke kanan. X ditambah Width harus tetap di dalam gedung.

fields.label: Depth (m)
fields.en: Size of the area from top to bottom. Y plus Depth must stay inside the building.
fields.id: Ukuran area dari atas ke bawah. Y ditambah Depth harus tetap di dalam gedung.

fields.label: Order
fields.en: Order of the area in lists, smallest first.
fields.id: Urutan area di daftar, yang terkecil lebih dulu.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Untick to take the area off the map. Its bins and stock records stay.
fields.id: Hilangkan centang untuk melepas area dari peta. Bin dan catatan stoknya tetap ada.

fields.label: Stack Height (m)
fields.en: How high goods may be stacked in this area. Empty = the clear height of that floor. Area x stack height is the storage volume, shared by the bins of the area.
fields.id: Setinggi apa barang boleh ditumpuk di area ini. Kosong = tinggi bersih lantainya. Luas x tinggi tumpuk = volume simpan, dibagi ke bin-bin area itu.

fields.label: Max. Stacked Pallets
fields.en: How many pallets may be stacked on one floor position. Empty = no limit: the stack is only monitored.
fields.id: Berapa palet boleh ditumpuk di satu tapak lantai. Kosong = tanpa batas: tumpukan hanya dipantau.

title: Bins

purpose.en: Every bin of every building: the place stock is kept in. Open it to change a bin capacity or storage area, to block a bin, or to type a single bin by hand.
purpose.id: Semua bin di semua gedung: tempat stok disimpan. Buka untuk mengubah kapasitas atau area sebuah bin, memblokir bin, atau mengetik satu bin sendiri.

keywords: bin, lokasi, location, rak, slot, lajur, kapasitas, capacity, blokir, block, kode bin, tambah bin

steps.en: Find the bin with the search box.
steps.id: Cari bin lewat kotak cari.

steps.en: Change Storage Area, Capacity (kg) or Pallets in the row.
steps.id: Ubah Storage Area, Capacity (kg), atau Pallets di barisnya.

steps.en: To block a bin untick Usable and type Blocked Because. Tick Usable again to use it.
steps.id: Untuk memblokir bin hilangkan centang Usable dan ketik Blocked Because. Centang Usable lagi untuk memakainya.

steps.en: To add one bin by hand, add a row and fill Building, Bin Code, Row, Column and Level. Many bins at once are made with Generate Bins on the Warehouse Map.
steps.id: Untuk menambah satu bin, tambah baris lalu isi Building, Bin Code, Row, Column, dan Level. Banyak bin sekaligus dibuat lewat Generate Bins di Warehouse Map.

steps.en: Click Save.
steps.id: Klik Save.

fields.label: Building
fields.en: The building of the bin. It cannot be changed after saving.
fields.id: Gedung tempat bin. Tidak bisa diubah setelah disimpan.

fields.label: Storage Area
fields.en: The area of that building the bin belongs to. A bin without an area is not drawn on the map.
fields.id: Area gedung itu yang memiliki bin. Bin tanpa area tidak digambar di peta.

fields.label: Bin Code
fields.en: The code printed on the label and on the stock card. It cannot be changed after saving.
fields.id: Kode yang tercetak di label dan di kartu stok. Tidak bisa diubah setelah disimpan.

fields.label: Short Name
fields.en: Short name shown in reports, for example PPR L03-05.
fields.id: Nama singkat yang tampil di laporan, misalnya PPR L03-05.

fields.label: Row
fields.en: Lane or rack of the bin. Bins with the same Row stand in one line on the map.
fields.id: Lajur atau rak bin. Bin dengan Row yang sama berdiri segaris di peta.

fields.label: Column
fields.en: Slot or rack column of the bin.
fields.id: Slot atau kolom rak bin.

fields.label: Level
fields.en: Rack level of the bin; 1 for a floor bin. Row, Column and Level together must be unique in a building.
fields.id: Tingkat rak bin; 1 untuk bin lantai. Row, Column, dan Level bersama-sama harus unik di satu gedung.

fields.label: Capacity (kg)
fields.en: Weight the bin may hold. The map compares it with the estimated weight of the stock inside.
fields.id: Berat yang boleh ditampung bin. Peta membandingkannya dengan perkiraan berat stok di dalamnya.

fields.label: Pallets
fields.en: Number of pallets that fit in the bin. Printed on the label.
fields.id: Jumlah pallet yang muat di bin. Tercetak di label.

fields.label: Usable
fields.en: Ticked = the bin may receive stock. Unticked = blocked: it is hatched on the map and cannot be a transfer destination.
fields.id: Dicentang = bin boleh menerima stok. Tidak dicentang = diblokir: berarsir di peta dan tidak bisa jadi tujuan transfer.

fields.label: Blocked Because
fields.en: Why the bin is blocked. Needed when Usable is unticked.
fields.id: Alasan bin diblokir. Wajib diisi bila Usable tidak dicentang.

fields.label: Active
fields.en: Untick a bin that no longer exists. It disappears from the map and the choices.
fields.id: Hilangkan centang untuk bin yang sudah tidak ada. Bin hilang dari peta dan pilihan.

title: Stock by Location

purpose.en: All stock on hand now, one row per item and bin, in every building. Open it to find where an item is kept or to list the dead stock.
purpose.id: Semua stok yang ada sekarang, satu baris per item per bin, di semua gedung. Buka untuk mencari tempat sebuah item disimpan atau mendaftar dead stock.

keywords: stock by location, stok per lokasi, stok per bin, posisi stok, dead stock, stok mati, cari barang, di mana barang, gudang, area, volume, kedaluwarsa, expired, tanggal tiba

steps.en: Type an item code, an item name or a bin code in the search box.
steps.id: Ketik kode item, nama item, atau kode bin di kotak cari.

steps.en: Click Dead stock above the table to see only the red rows.
steps.id: Klik Dead stock di atas tabel untuk melihat baris merah saja.

steps.en: Use Filters for Class, Building, Storage Area or Stock, and Group to get a subtotal per building, area, bin or item.
steps.id: Pakai Filters untuk Class, Building, Storage Area, atau Stock, dan Group untuk subtotal per gedung, area, bin, atau item.

fields.label: Item
fields.en: Item name with its code below.
fields.id: Nama item dengan kodenya di bawah.

fields.label: Class
fields.en: RM = raw material, SFG = semi finished goods, FG = finished goods.
fields.id: RM = bahan baku, SFG = barang setengah jadi, FG = barang jadi.

fields.label: Building
fields.en: The warehouse building of the bin.
fields.id: Gedung gudang tempat bin berada.

fields.label: Storage Area
fields.en: The area of the bin. No area = the bin has not been given an area yet.
fields.id: Area tempat bin berada. No area = bin belum diberi area.

fields.label: Bin
fields.en: The bin code.
fields.id: Kode bin.

fields.label: On Hand
fields.en: Quantity in that bin now, from the last stock card row.
fields.id: Qty di bin itu sekarang, dari baris kartu stok terakhir.

fields.label: Weight (kg)
fields.en: Estimated weight: KG items by quantity, paper sheets by grammage and size. Empty when it cannot be estimated.
fields.id: Perkiraan berat: item KG dari qty-nya, lembaran kertas dari gramatur dan ukurannya. Kosong bila tidak bisa diperkirakan.

fields.label: Stock Value
fields.en: Value of the stock in that bin at the moving average price.
fields.id: Nilai stok di bin itu dengan harga rata-rata bergerak.

fields.label: Last Movement
fields.en: Date of the last movement of the item in any bin. Stock transfers are not counted.
fields.id: Tanggal pergerakan terakhir item di bin mana pun. Stock transfer tidak dihitung.

fields.label: Idle (days)
fields.en: Days since the last movement.
fields.id: Jumlah hari sejak pergerakan terakhir.

fields.label: Stock
fields.en: OK, Dead stock (idle longer than the limit, or never moved) or Blocked bin.
fields.id: OK, Dead stock (diam lebih lama dari batas, atau tidak pernah bergerak), atau Blocked bin.

fields.label: Volume (m³)
fields.en: Estimated volume of the stock (paper: sheets x size x thickness). Empty when it cannot be estimated.
fields.id: Perkiraan volume stok (kertas: lembar x ukuran x tebal). Kosong bila tidak bisa diperkirakan.

fields.label: Arrived
fields.en: The date the goods came into that bin.
fields.id: Tanggal barang masuk ke bin itu.

fields.label: Expiry Date
fields.en: The earliest expiry date among the pallet labels of that stock. Expired rows are red, Expires soon rows yellow.
fields.id: Tanggal kedaluwarsa paling awal dari label palet stok itu. Baris Expired merah, Expires soon kuning.

title: Print Location Label (QR)

purpose.en: Print a label for every bin: its code, storage area, capacity (weight, volume, floor area), a QR code and a barcode. The colour band shows the kind of storage area.
purpose.id: Mencetak label untuk tiap bin: kode, area penyimpanan, kapasitas (berat, volume, luas tapak), QR code, dan barcode. Pita warna menunjukkan jenis area penyimpanan.

keywords: label lokasi, location label, label bin, label rak, qr code, barcode, cetak label, capacity label, label kapasitas

steps.en: Choose the Building and click Show. Choose a Storage area and click Show to tick all its bins.
steps.id: Pilih Building lalu klik Show. Pilih Storage area lalu klik Show untuk mencentang semua bin-nya.

steps.en: Tick the Bins to print, or untick the ones you do not need.
steps.id: Centang Bins yang dicetak, atau lepas centang yang tidak perlu.

steps.en: Choose the Label size and the Copies per label, then click Print.
steps.id: Pilih Label size dan Copies per label, lalu klik Print.

steps.en: The label sheet opens. Click Print there; only the labels are printed. The print is recorded in Label Print History.
steps.id: Lembar label terbuka. Klik Print di sana; hanya labelnya yang tercetak. Cetakan tercatat di Label Print History.

fields.label: Building
fields.en: The building whose bins are listed.
fields.id: Gedung yang bin-nya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Storage area (ticks all its bins)
fields.en: Optional. Choosing an area ticks all its bins at once.
fields.id: Boleh kosong. Memilih area mencentang semua bin-nya sekaligus.

fields.label: Bins
fields.en: The bins that get a label.
fields.id: Bin yang dicetak labelnya.

fields.label: Label size
fields.en: 60 x 40 mm (small packs), 100 x 50 mm (bins and stacks) or 100 x 150 mm (pallets). The guide under the form shows what each size is for and how many fit on an A4 sheet.
fields.id: 60 x 40 mm (kemasan kecil), 100 x 50 mm (bin dan tumpukan), atau 100 x 150 mm (palet). Panduan di bawah form menjelaskan guna tiap ukuran dan berapa yang muat di satu lembar A4.

fields.label: Copies per label
fields.en: How many times each label is printed, 1 to 20.
fields.id: Berapa kali tiap label dicetak, 1 sampai 20.

fields.label: Print On
fields.en: Label roll = a label printer, one label per page. A4 sheet = an office printer, the labels are cut along their borders.
fields.id: Label roll = printer label, satu label satu halaman. A4 sheet = printer kantor, label dipotong mengikuti garis tepinya.

title: Print Pallet Label (QR)

purpose.en: Give every pallet its own label: pallet number, item, quantity, arrival date, the pallet code of the supplier, lot, expiry date, a QR code and a barcode. A label is made at every arrival and again every time stock is used from the pallet.
purpose.id: Memberi tiap palet labelnya sendiri: nomor palet, item, qty, tanggal tiba, kode palet dari supplier, lot, tanggal kedaluwarsa, QR code, dan barcode. Label dibuat setiap barang datang dan dibuat lagi setiap isi palet dipakai.

keywords: label palet, pallet label, palet, pallet, kedatangan, penerimaan barang, label ulang, relabel, sisa palet, kode palet supplier, kedaluwarsa, expired, expiry, tanggal tiba, qr code, barcode, ukuran label, cetak label, sisa, remnant, rim, stack

steps.en: At a goods receipt: open the posted receipt and click Pallet Labels. Or open this screen from the menu and choose the Building.
steps.id: Saat penerimaan barang: buka penerimaan yang sudah diposting lalu klik Pallet Labels. Atau buka layar ini dari menu dan pilih Building.

steps.en: Read the work list. Arrival label = goods came in and have no pallet label yet. Relabel after use = stock was taken and a pallet label still shows the old quantity.
steps.id: Baca daftar pekerjaan. Arrival label = barang datang dan belum punya label palet. Relabel after use = stok sudah diambil dan label palet masih menunjukkan qty lama.

steps.en: Open a row. For an arrival: one line = one pallet. Type the quantity on each pallet, the pallet code printed on the supplier label, the lot and the expiry date; use + Pallet to split. Click Create & Print.
steps.id: Buka satu baris. Untuk kedatangan: satu baris = satu palet. Ketik qty tiap palet, kode palet yang tercetak di label supplier, lot, dan tanggal kedaluwarsa; pakai + Pallet untuk memecah. Klik Create & Print.

steps.en: After using stock from a pallet: choose the pallet under Relabel after Use, type what is left and click Relabel & Print. Zero closes the pallet.
steps.id: Sesudah memakai stok dari satu palet: pilih paletnya di Relabel after Use, ketik sisanya, lalu klik Relabel & Print. Nol menutup palet.

steps.en: A damaged or lost label: tick the pallet under Print Again and click Print. The quantity does not change.
steps.id: Label rusak atau hilang: centang paletnya di Print Again lalu klik Print. Qty tidak berubah.

steps.en: The label sheet opens. Choose Label Roll or A4 Sheet, then Print. Stick the label on the pallet before it is put away.
steps.id: Lembar label terbuka. Pilih Label Roll atau A4 Sheet, lalu Print. Tempel label di palet sebelum disimpan.

steps.en: Unit kind: Automatic makes a remnant pack when sheets are at or below the remnant limit. Choose Pallet or Pack yourself for goods counted in kg or pieces.
steps.id: Unit kind: Automatic membuat pak sisa bila lembaran sama dengan atau di bawah batas sisa. Pilih Pallet atau Pack sendiri untuk barang yang dihitung dalam kg atau pcs.

steps.en: Relabel after Use: if the remnant was put on another pile, choose that bin in Now in bin. A Stock Transfer is made and confirmed, and the pack goes on top of that pile.
steps.id: Relabel after Use: bila sisa ditaruh di tumpukan lain, pilih bin-nya di Now in bin. Stock Transfer dibuat dan di-Confirm, dan pak itu menjadi paling atas di tumpukan itu.

fields.label: Qty on the Pallet
fields.en: What is on that pallet. All new pallets together may not be more than what is in the bin without a label.
fields.id: Isi palet itu. Jumlah semua palet baru tidak boleh lebih dari isi bin yang belum berlabel.

fields.label: Supplier Pallet Code
fields.en: The pallet code printed on the label of the supplier. It is printed on our label too, so a pallet can be traced back to the supplier.
fields.id: Kode palet yang tercetak di label supplier. Ikut dicetak di label kita, supaya palet bisa dilacak balik ke supplier.

fields.label: Expiry Date
fields.en: Paper and ink expire. The date is proposed from the arrival date and the shelf life of the item (master Raw Material); change it to the date on the supplier label. Expired pallets get a red tag, pallets that expire soon a yellow tag.
fields.id: Kertas dan tinta punya tanggal kedaluwarsa. Tanggal diusulkan dari tanggal tiba dan umur simpan item (master Raw Material); ganti dengan tanggal di label supplier. Palet kedaluwarsa bertanda merah, yang segera kedaluwarsa bertanda kuning.

fields.label: Arrival date
fields.en: The date the goods arrived. It stays on the label after a relabel. The colour band of the label shows the arrival month.
fields.id: Tanggal barang tiba. Tetap sama di label sesudah dilabel ulang. Pita warna label menunjukkan bulan tiba.

fields.label: Label size
fields.en: 60 x 40 mm (small packs), 100 x 50 mm (bins and stacks) or 100 x 150 mm (pallets). The guide under the form shows what each size is for and how many fit on an A4 sheet.
fields.id: 60 x 40 mm (kemasan kecil), 100 x 50 mm (bin dan tumpukan), atau 100 x 150 mm (palet). Panduan di bawah form menjelaskan guna tiap ukuran dan berapa yang muat di satu lembar A4.

fields.label: Print On
fields.en: Label roll = a label printer, one label per page. A4 sheet = an office printer, the labels are cut along their borders.
fields.id: Label roll = printer label, satu label satu halaman. A4 sheet = printer kantor, label dipotong mengikuti garis tepinya.

fields.label: Remaining quantity
fields.en: What is left on the pallet after use. It may not be more than the quantity at arrival.
fields.id: Sisa isi palet sesudah dipakai. Tidak boleh lebih dari qty saat tiba.

fields.label: Stack No.
fields.en: Place of the unit in the stack of its bin; 1 is the bottom. New units go on top; when a unit leaves, the ones above move down.
fields.id: Letak satuan dalam tumpukan bin-nya; 1 paling bawah. Satuan baru menjadi paling atas; saat satu satuan keluar, yang di atasnya turun.

fields.label: Kind
fields.en: Pallet = a full or opened pallet. Remnant = a pack of loose reams, boxes or cans; it gets the small label with its bin and stack number.
fields.id: Pallet = palet penuh atau terbuka. Remnant = pak rim, dus, atau kaleng lepas; mendapat label kecil berisi bin dan nomor tumpukannya.

fields.label: Now in bin
fields.en: Where the remnant is after use. Stays in the same bin, or another bin: then the stock is moved there with a Stock Transfer.
fields.id: Tempat sisa itu sesudah dipakai. Tetap di bin yang sama, atau bin lain: stoknya dipindah ke sana dengan Stock Transfer.

title: Print Item Label (QR)

purpose.en: Print labels for stock that is in a bin now: item, quantity, bin, arrival date, lot and expiry date, a QR code and a barcode. The colour band shows the stock class; a red stripe means dead stock or expired. Not the same as the pallet label.
purpose.id: Mencetak label untuk stok yang sekarang ada di bin: item, qty, bin, tanggal tiba, lot dan tanggal kedaluwarsa, QR code, dan barcode. Pita warna menunjukkan kelas stok; garis merah = dead stock atau kedaluwarsa. Berbeda dari label palet.

keywords: label item, item label, label barang, label stok, qr code, barcode, cetak label, dead stock, penerimaan barang, goods receipt, tanggal tiba, kedaluwarsa, ukuran label

steps.en: At a goods receipt: open the posted receipt and click Item Labels. The items of that receipt are already ticked.
steps.id: Saat penerimaan barang: buka penerimaan yang sudah diposting lalu klik Item Labels. Item penerimaan itu sudah tercentang.

steps.en: Choose the Building and click Show.
steps.id: Pilih Building lalu klik Show.

steps.en: Tick the stock to label. Each choice is one item in one bin with its quantity on hand.
steps.id: Centang stok yang diberi label. Tiap pilihan adalah satu item di satu bin beserta qty yang ada.

steps.en: Choose the Label size and the Copies per label, then click Print.
steps.id: Pilih Label size dan Copies per label, lalu klik Print.

steps.en: The label sheet opens. Click Print there. The print is recorded in Label Print History.
steps.id: Lembar label terbuka. Klik Print di sana. Cetakan tercatat di Label Print History.

fields.label: Building
fields.en: The building whose stock is listed.
fields.id: Gedung yang stoknya ditampilkan.

fields.label: Stock (item | bin | on hand)
fields.en: Stock positions of that building. DEAD STOCK is written behind the ones that are dead.
fields.id: Posisi stok gedung itu. DEAD STOCK tertulis di belakang yang sudah mati.

fields.label: Label size
fields.en: 60 x 40 mm (small packs), 100 x 50 mm (bins and stacks) or 100 x 150 mm (pallets). The guide under the form shows what each size is for and how many fit on an A4 sheet.
fields.id: 60 x 40 mm (kemasan kecil), 100 x 50 mm (bin dan tumpukan), atau 100 x 150 mm (palet). Panduan di bawah form menjelaskan guna tiap ukuran dan berapa yang muat di satu lembar A4.

fields.label: Copies per label
fields.en: How many times each label is printed, 1 to 20.
fields.id: Berapa kali tiap label dicetak, 1 sampai 20.

fields.label: Print On
fields.en: Label roll = a label printer, one label per page. A4 sheet = an office printer, the labels are cut along their borders.
fields.id: Label roll = printer label, satu label satu halaman. A4 sheet = printer kantor, label dipotong mengikuti garis tepinya.

title: Label Print History

purpose.en: Who printed which label, when and how many copies. Open it to check whether a bin or an item already has its label.
purpose.id: Siapa mencetak label apa, kapan, dan berapa lembar. Buka untuk memeriksa apakah sebuah bin atau item sudah punya label.

keywords: label print history, riwayat cetak label, riwayat label, siapa cetak label, qr code, barcode

steps.en: Type a bin code, an item code or a login in the search box.
steps.id: Ketik kode bin, kode item, atau login di kotak cari.

steps.en: Use Filters for Label, Size or Printed By, and Group for a subtotal of copies.
steps.id: Pakai Filters untuk Label, Size, atau Printed By, dan Group untuk subtotal jumlah lembar.

steps.en: The label screens fill this report: each Print adds one row per label, with up to 20 copies. Click Print History on those screens to come here.
steps.id: Layar cetak label mengisi laporan ini: tiap Print menambah satu baris per label, maksimal 20 lembar. Klik Print History di layar itu untuk datang ke sini.

steps.en: Copies is added up in the Total row at the bottom. Export downloads a CSV file of the visible columns and the filtered rows; choose the columns first with Columns.
steps.id: Copies dijumlahkan di baris Total di bawah. Export mengunduh file CSV berisi kolom yang tampil dan baris hasil filter; pilih kolomnya lebih dulu dengan Columns.

fields.label: Printed At
fields.en: Date and time of the print.
fields.id: Tanggal dan jam cetak.

fields.label: Label
fields.en: Kind of label printed: Location = bin label, Item = item label, Pallet = pallet label. A Label filter and a Group choice use the same values.
fields.id: Jenis label yang dicetak: Location = label bin, Item = label item, Pallet = label pallet. Filter Label dan pilihan Group memakai nilai yang sama.

fields.label: Code
fields.en: The code on the label: the bin code, the item code or the pallet number.
fields.id: Kode di label: kode bin, kode item, atau nomor pallet.

fields.label: Name
fields.en: Location: the storage area of the bin. Item and Pallet: the item name with its bin (a Pallet label also shows the item code first).
fields.id: Location: area penyimpanan bin. Item dan Pallet: nama item beserta bin-nya (label Pallet juga menampilkan kode item di depan).

fields.label: Qty on Label
fields.en: Item and Pallet labels: the quantity printed on the label. Empty for a Location label.
fields.id: Label Item dan Pallet: qty yang tercetak di label. Kosong untuk label Location.

fields.label: Copies
fields.en: How many copies were asked for.
fields.id: Jumlah lembar yang diminta.

fields.label: Size
fields.en: sm = 60 x 35 mm, md = 100 x 50 mm, lg = 100 x 150 mm.
fields.id: sm = 60 x 35 mm, md = 100 x 50 mm, lg = 100 x 150 mm.

fields.label: Printed By
fields.en: Login of the person who printed.
fields.id: Login orang yang mencetak.

fields.label: Unit
fields.en: Unit of measure of Qty on Label, filled by the system when the label is printed. Empty for a Location label and when the item has no unit.
fields.id: Satuan dari Qty on Label, diisi sistem saat label dicetak. Kosong untuk label Location dan bila item tidak punya satuan.

title: Track via QR/Barcode

purpose.en: Scan a label or type a code to see at once what it is: the content of a bin, where an item is kept, or a stock transfer.
purpose.id: Pindai label atau ketik kode untuk langsung melihat isinya: isi sebuah bin, tempat sebuah item disimpan, atau sebuah stock transfer.

keywords: scan, pindai, qr code, barcode, lacak, track, cari bin, cari barang, scanner, kamera, hp, palet, pallet, nomor palet, kedaluwarsa

steps.en: Click in the box and scan the label with the scanner, or type the code and press Enter.
steps.id: Klik di kotak lalu pindai label dengan scanner, atau ketik kodenya dan tekan Enter.

steps.en: On a phone that opens the page over https, the camera button scans a QR code or a barcode.
steps.id: Di HP yang membuka halaman lewat https, tombol kamera memindai QR code atau barcode.

steps.en: A bin code shows the bin label, its capacity and the items inside. Show on Map opens the Warehouse Map on that bin.
steps.id: Kode bin menampilkan label bin, kapasitasnya, dan item di dalamnya. Show on Map membuka Warehouse Map di bin itu.

steps.en: An item code shows every bin that holds the item and its 15 latest movements.
steps.id: Kode item menampilkan semua bin yang berisi item itu dan 15 pergerakan terakhirnya.

steps.en: A transfer number shows a button that opens the Stock Transfer.
steps.id: Nomor transfer menampilkan tombol yang membuka Stock Transfer-nya.

steps.en: Scan a pallet label to see the pallet: item, quantity now and at arrival, supplier pallet code, expiry date, its bin and its history. Move this Pallet makes a transfer for it; Relabel / Print opens Print Pallet Label.
steps.id: Pindai label palet untuk melihat paletnya: item, qty sekarang dan saat tiba, kode palet supplier, tanggal kedaluwarsa, bin-nya dan riwayatnya. Move this Pallet membuat transfer untuk palet itu; Relabel / Print membuka Print Pallet Label.

fields.label: Scan or type a code, then Enter
fields.en: A bin code, an item code, a transfer number, or the content of a QR code from a label.
fields.id: Kode bin, kode item, nomor transfer, atau isi QR code dari label.
